$comment: Time-boxed exceptions for npm audit HIGH/CRITICAL advisories. Enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry (max ~60 days). Remove entries as soon as a fixed version is installable. Policy: docs/security/dependency-exceptions.md

exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI (prisma@7.10.1 -> @prisma/config@7.10.1 -> effect@3.20.0, devDependency in packages/db). Dev-only CLI tooling, never in the API or web bundle; no Prisma 7.10 patch fixes it (npm fix downgrades Prisma to 6.12.0, which ADR-004 forbids).
